summary: Galapagos NV filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual and Extraordinary Shareholders Meetings held on April 28, 2026. The meetings covered routine items: approval of non-consolidated annual accounts, remuneration report, director releases, and appointments of executive director Henry Gosebruch and independent non-executive director Jane Griffiths, along with other board appointments. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring was disclosed. This is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer.
